system.description:
The Ravnos scrambles a target's senses — or an entire crowd's — into a disorienting synesthesia that leaves them barely able to function.

System: Against a single target, the Ravnos spends one Willpower and rolls Manipulation + Intimidation (difficulty equal to the victim's Willpower). Against a crowd, the difficulty is 7 and affects everyone in the Ravnos's line of sight, reducing each victim's Perception by one per success (Perception 0 leaves a victim totally incapacitated). Duration against a single victim scales with successes: 1 = one week, 2 = one month, 3 = six months, 4 = one year, 5 = permanent. Against a crowd, the effect lasts until sunrise.

MET: Ascendant Discipline. The Ravnos spends one Willpower Trait and wins a Static Social Challenge (difficulty 12 Traits), then spends one Social Trait per target affected. Affected targets must spend one Willpower Trait merely to act at all, must bid two Traits in all challenges, and automatically lose all ties. The effect lasts until sunrise or until the Ravnos releases the target.
system.duration: Up to permanent (single target) or until sunrise (crowd)
